protocol.split: Whole episode; no random transition split
protocol.encoder: Frozen batch00 behavior AHGNN used for both splits
protocol.trainable: Existing 256->128->1 GraphCritic only; all its parameters
protocol.loss: Mean of eight per-episode MSEs; final step fixed beforehand; validation never used to select step
protocol.target: Captured aligned remaining-time Monte Carlo return G=-(C-t)/300

limitations: Validation batch01 was generated by the slightly updated batch00 candidate policy; a small policy/occupancy shift exists.
One stochastic trajectory per seed yields a noisy Monte Carlo target, not the conditional expected value; irreducible variance cannot be estimated here.
Batch00 zero-initialized critic and captured batch01 critic values are reported separately; captured_behavior_critic uses the behavior version for each split.
Original round17 critic has an older reward protocol/scale; its MSE is a diagnostic of incompatibility, not a fair aligned-value baseline.
Frozen features may omit information needed to predict completion; poor validation can reflect aliasing, episode shift, limited data or optimization and cannot uniquely identify which.
This offline fit changes only an isolated critic copy; no policy update or physical performance claim.
